fieldNotes.site: Ball retrofitted a ~1,078,799 sq ft former Techneglas building at 140 Industrial Dr, Jenkins Township (CenterPoint Commerce & Trade Park East); can production began mid-2021. One very large single building, long axis ~E-W (slight tilt).
fieldNotes.truckGate: No per-building gate or guard booth visible; the building's north truck court and lots open directly onto CenterPoint park spine roads (Street View shows open, un-barriered access). Classed as no-gate/no-guard, flagged medium — security may exist at building doors rather than a road barrier.
fieldNotes.docks: Continuous dock bank along the south face (rail-side) plus docks on the north/west faces of the building; 50+ total across faces (estimate ~60). Ship/receive plausibly split across separate faces -> shipRcvSeparate true (flagged).
fieldNotes.dropYards: South drop yard holds a long trailer row; a large paved OVERFLOW/staging lot sits at the NW. Combined capacity ~150 trailers, ~45 visible.
fieldNotes.railServed: A double-track freight rail line runs immediately along the SW/west property edge, but no spur enters the building -> railServed false (spur-add is physically feasible given the adjacency).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Jenkins Township industrial park at the wooded edge of the Scranton-Wilkes-Barre metro, adjacent residential subdivision + I-81; classed Rural (edge-of-town industrial-park setting). Cell coverage fine (I-81 corridor).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~88 acres estimated for building + north court + south drop yard + NW overflow lot; perimeter is an approximate oriented trace.

citations.claim: Ball's own Feb-2025 locations map lists Pittston, PA as an operating site.
Ball retrofitting the 1,078,799 sq ft Jenkins Township building into an aluminum beverage can plant; ~$300M, ~230 jobs; production 2021.

verification.rationale: New (2021) Ball can plant, confirmed current on Ball's own 2025 locations map; not among Ball's 2022-24 closures (Phoenix/St. Paul/Kent/Verona).
